settings.heading: SUSTAINABILITY IN EVERY KNOT: CHOOSING ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIALS

settings.text:
Water-intensive fibres, hazardous dyes, and chemical treatments used in rug manufacture can have an effect on the environment from the raw material extraction to the final product. But with us, things don't have to be this way. We ensure that our rugs not only improve the visual appeal of your house but also support a more sustainable and healthy environment. Using sustainable materials, we have been consistently working to reduce waste, conserve resources, and use ethical standards at every stage of the production process. We work hard to create luxurious rugs that honour our mission to preserve the environment and uplift local communities.

ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIALS: SUSTAINABLE FROM THE GROUND UP-

ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIALS: SUSTAINABLE FROM THE GROUND UP-Our impactful journey of being eco-friendly begins with the selection of natural and renewable fibers. We carefully choose materials such as:

  • Organic Cotton: We have been using organic cotton which is free from harmful pesticides and fertilizers. It uses very less water and energy with compare to conventional cotton which even makes it a more sustainable choice. By using organic cotton we help farmers and promote soil-friendly farming practices.
  • Wool: We get our wool from a fixed set of cattle, which ensures the consistency in quality of raw material. As we know wool is a naturally renewable and biodegradable fibre, it fits very well with our eco-friendly material strategy. Wool is a kind of fiber which helps in controlling moisture and temperature since it is resilient and naturally insulating. Additionally, we ensure that the cattle are cared for and not just used for buisness purposes.

settings.title: MADE IN A SUSTAINABLE WAY. MADE BY HAND.
settings.text: In addition to using exclusively natural materials, handcrafted goods are made using traditional small-batch craft methods that produce little waste and few carbon emissions.

settings.title: FASHION WITH PURPOSE
settings.text: We guarantee that our items not only look fantastic but also promote ethical labour practices and environmentally friendly manufacture by utilising sustainable, ethically obtained materials. It is fashion that has a beneficial effect.

settings.title: ECO-FRIENDLY FABRICS, BEAUTIFUL RESULTS
settings.text: Our materials are carefully chosen to minimise pollution and waste, providing you with eco-friendly, fashionable options. Fashion that is both environmentally friendly and healthy for you.
